احتسوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَسَوْا (iḥtasaw) /iħ.ta.saw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# اُحْتُسُوا (uḥtusū) /uħ.tu.suː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# اِحْتَسُوا (iḥtasū) /iħ.ta.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
